csv_scope_of_work: The City of Boston Economic Opportunity and Inclusion Cabinet is seeking proposals in response to this Request for Proposals (RFP), for a consultant to assist the City in designing and conducting a comprehensive Disparity Study. The requested services will be completed across two project phases. The study should examine the extent to which a disparity exists between the availability of qualified small and diverse businesses and their actual utilization as contractors and subcontractors.
